# Charles Shima

> Charles Shima is the Architect of the Travelpreneur™ Economy. He helps travel creators turn what they know into income, beyond brand deals. He is the founder of Tourifique and ZaNiheza, and a global speaker on the creator economy, AI in travel, and Rwanda beyond safari. Website: https://shimacharles.ca

Born in Kinshasa (Democratic Republic of the Congo) and raised in Rwanda, Charles Shima lost his mother at 9 and his father at 13, fled Rwanda in 1994 at 16, and arrived in Canada at 19 with no money. He built a career at RBC, CMHC and BC Housing before founding Tourifique. He has spoken at Web Summit Vancouver (Black Innovation Zone), Black Travel Expo (Atlanta), Phocuswright and the ProColombia Vancouver Summit, and has been featured by BIPOC Foundation and Black Business Magazine.

## Definitions
- Travelpreneur™: a travel creator or travel-savvy entrepreneur who earns from what they know about travel, through offers they own (webinars, coaching, e-guides, digital services, curated experiences), instead of relying only on brand deals.
- Travelpreneur™ Economy: the growing economy of travel creators, entrepreneurs and suppliers who turn travel knowledge into income and bookable experiences.

## How Charles Shima helps
- Build with Tourifique: Tourifique connects Travellers, Travelpreneurs and Suppliers through short-form travel reels. Discover through video, book the experience behind it, and let creators earn from their knowledge. https://tourifique.com
- Storytelling & content: short-form video stories that turn viewers into bookers.
- AI for travel creators: four concrete jobs — scripting, repurposing one reel into a guide, itinerary or e-guide, enquiry follow-up, and destination research.
- Speaking: keynotes, panels and workshops.
- Coaching & mentorship: from first offer to first income.
